prior_development_exposure: Updater repaired after v37 training-feedback failures; same cohort reused, independent/main results not inspected. This is a second development experiment, not a fresh training sample.
repairs: Separate explicit success/failure pools with input excerpts
Concrete invalid IDs plus legal replacement pool in schema repair
Only source-quote-valid roots with reference_status supported can sponsor skill proposals
Reflect on all observed errors, avoiding RxSafe majority subsampling
Exactly one narrow trigger; at most one retrieval parameter; no broad age or option-length predicates
Data-bound trigger-term patches can repair missed observable conditions; fixed matcher code
Guard is non-regression on each task; proposal still requires pooled improvement; no independent/test outcomes used to set this rule
external_proposer: anthropic/claude-opus-4.8; actor/root reflector remains deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash; unequal training compute explicitly disclosed
root_replay: Cumulative quote-validated training root bank through the current round; never include future rounds; recent failures and best positive-net rejected probes remain visible. Roots retain originating state hashes; candidate probes re-evaluate the incumbent.
null_handling: An explicit null card is a valid abstention, not a schema error; never force a repair into unsupported content. Preserve diagnosis in the intervention ledger.
updater_context: Short stable IDs; one selected root-feature cluster; at most6 roots,10 failures,10 successes; explicit detector mismatch; no full400-case context
root_source_checks: Exact input/source quotation verification; hypotheses remain unproven until intervention.
gate: At least2 net probe corrections; no loss on each proposal task with positive pooled delta; no loss on each guard task (independent non-regression gate). No independent/test feedback.
shortcuts: No numeric calibrator or raw training case retrieval in actor; no medication names allowed in skill procedure; no caseID or target letter in actor memory.
memory: Rejected candidate diagnoses and observed regressions persist to inform later proposals. Successfully retained procedural cards and regional retrieval configurations are the learned state.
